description: Builds one SPF record (TXT at the domain) from the services that send for it: includes, IPv4 and IPv6, mx and a. Starts with ~all (softfail), the safe choice; use policy fail (-all) once every sender is listed. Remember the limit of 10 DNS lookups (each include costs at least one). Free, no network. / Monta o registro SPF a partir dos serviços que enviam pelo domínio.

a.description: The domain's own address may send

mx.description: Servers in the domain's MX may send

name: generate_spf
title: Generate an SPF record / Gerar registro SPF
